packageRules.description: Link digest-pinned GitHub dependencies to the diff between the two commits
Only suggest updates that stay within the go directive, so a dependency bump never raises the minimum Go version consumers need
examples/ replaces the root module, so its go.sum goes stale whenever root dependencies move and `make generate` then fails. Updating both modules in one PR lets gomodTidy run across both.
Do not bump CI's Go toolchain on its own. Building only on a newer Go stops us verifying the minimum version go.mod declares, so a newer-only API could land unnoticed and break consumers.

customManagers.description: Track the golangci-lint version pinned in the Makefile's go install line
